hero.desc: A modern, ultra-fast launcher with the same visual language as the Slaumcher desktop app. Microsoft accounts, versions, and tools in one place.

features.title: Designed like the launcher
features.subtitle: The same glass UI, type, and surfaces you use inside the app — now on the web.
features.f1_desc: Blurred cards, soft borders, and subtle hover states. Same chrome as the dashboard.
features.f2_desc: Secure sign-in with official accounts. Your tokens stay on your machine.
features.f3_desc: Skin view, capes, and profile tools built into the launcher.
features.f4_desc: Electron + React tuned for fast startup and low memory use.

download.title: Cross-platform
download.subtitle: Pick your OS. The recommended option is highlighted based on what we detect.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: At Slaumcher we take your privacy seriously. We do not collect invasive telemetry, sell your data, or track your gaming sessions.
privacy.p2: Your Microsoft tokens are stored locally on your own machine.
privacy.p3: If you have questions, you can review the open-source code in our repository.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.p1: The software is provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. Slaumcher is not an official product of Minecraft, Mojang Studios, or Microsoft, and is not affiliated with them.
terms.p2: Using this launcher requires a legitimate copy of Minecraft linked to a valid Microsoft account when applicable.
